source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 15. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: The Prophet's ﷺ birth in Makkah and how Allah protected the Ka'bah

learn.en: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant, the year 570.
learn.title: A special year

learn.en: Before Islam, the Arabs didn't number their years. They named each year after a big event.
learn.title: Naming the years

learn.en: Abraha, the ruler of Yemen, was jealous because so many people visited the Ka'bah in Makkah.
learn.title: A jealous ruler

learn.en: He built a splendid church in San'aa so people would come there instead — but they kept visiting the Ka'bah.
learn.title: Abraha's plan

learn.en: Furious, Abraha marched to Makkah with a big army and an elephant at the front, to knock down the Ka'bah.
learn.title: The march

learn.en: Near Makkah, the elephant stopped and would not move. Allah sent flocks of birds carrying stones of hard clay.
learn.title: Allah protects the Ka'bah

learn.en: This story is in Surat Al-Fil. The Prophet ﷺ was born 50 days later.
learn.title: In the Qur'an

quiz.en: Where was Prophet Muhammad ﷺ born?
What did Abraha put at the front of his army?
What did Abraha want to do?
True or false? No one in Makkah had ever seen an elephant before.
True or false? Abraha was the ruler of Yemen at that time.
True or false? People stopped visiting the Ka'bah and went to Abraha's church instead.

think.q: Why do you think the elephant refused to walk towards Makkah?
think.a: Because Allah protected His House, the Ka'bah — no army is stronger than Allah.

parents.summary: The Prophet ﷺ was born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant (570), when Allah protected the Ka'bah from Abraha's army.
parents.tip: Tell the story of the elephant together with toy animals.
